items.title: The dropped torch
must: One Hero only; the shapes stay vague
Every figure has exactly two arms, two hands and two legs; shoulders, elbows, wrists and knees bend only the natural way, no limb twists behind the body or merges into another figure
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air
Both arms stay in front of the body; the sword is entirely out of its scabbard, one straight blade continuing from one crossguard in the hand
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No detailed Monster.
Not the Undercroft or the Shadowed Under Passage.
No glow effect around the torch.

items.title: The ratkin swarm
must: The ratkin read as one swarm, not separate portraits
Ratkin are upright humanoid rat-folk about the size of a Halfling, never ordinary rats on all fours
Every figure has exactly two arms, two hands and two legs; shoulders, elbows, wrists and knees bend only the natural way, no limb twists behind the body or merges into another figure
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Ratkin ancestry or bestiary portraits.
No ordinary rats or animals on all fours.
No gore.
No Heroes in frame.

items.title: Camouflage
must: The archer is mostly hidden; the cover dominates
Both halves of the bowstring are fully visible and each ends exactly at a bow tip; no fern covers the string or the lower limb
The bow is one whole bow with its string attached at both tips and the arrow on the string
Every figure has exactly two arms, two hands and two legs; shoulders, elbows, wrists and knees bend only the natural way, no limb twists behind the body or merges into another figure
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No full figure.
Not the Scout background or the Ranger class figure.
No enemies.

items.title: One moves, one waits
must: Two Heroes only, clearly on the same side
Every figure has exactly two arms, two hands and two legs; shoulders, elbows, wrists and knees bend only the natural way, no limb twists behind the body or merges into another figure
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air
The crossbow's bow arms are clearly visible spreading to both sides of the front of the stock, and the string runs from each bow tip back to the trigger catch; it must not look like a rifle
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No enemies in frame.
Not the chapter 3 dawn gathering.
No banners.

items.title: Steadfast Word
must: Exactly two figures; the Paladin is lifting, not striking
Every figure has exactly two arms, two hands and two legs; shoulders, elbows, wrists and knees bend only the natural way, no limb twists behind the body or merges into another figure
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air
The only contact is one hand on one upper arm; every hand belongs visibly to one arm and no two arms join or merge
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
No halo, sunburst or radiant glow.
Not the Tier 1 lantern-healing priest or the Tier 2 roadside shrine.
No longsword drawn and no enemy in frame.

items.title: Staff, sword, and symbol
must: Only these three objects
Every weapon and tool is one whole, correctly built object that is gripped by a visible hand, sheathed, or resting on a surface; nothing floats in the air

All three objects lie flat on the stone side by side, none crossing or resting on another, each touching the stone along its whole length with its shadow directly beneath it; both ends of the staff are on the stone
avoid: No lettering, numbers, dice, game tokens, or rulebook pages.
Not the Magic in the Dying Lands altar still life.
No runes or glyphs.
No glow.
